purpose: Domain-specific change propagation using allocated requirements, derived inputs and Product Definition slices; fail closed while avoiding unnecessary rebuilds.
principles: The authoritative engineering build graph is the only transitive stale/rebuild topology.
Relationship registry supplies entity-to-graph seed mapping and cross-part/interface review context; it does not duplicate numerical engineering requirements.
Every derived artifact stores the state fingerprint of its consumed inputs. Fingerprint mismatch means STALE; status is never manually reset to PASS.
A change to one part never silently rewrites another part. If a shared interface may be affected, counterpart parts are REVIEW_REQUIRED and their dependent verification chain is invalidated.
OPEN remains OPEN through propagation and rebuild. Rebuild cannot create a tolerance, fit, GD&T, roughness, process or acceptance value that upstream Product Definition did not control.
Visual-only drawing changes must not invalidate Product Definition, CAD geometry, BOM or analysis nodes.
Interface/requirement/material/geometry changes are engineering changes; they must run pre-change impact analysis before write for Class A/B change control.
Automatic execution is separated from automatic invalidation: stale propagation is automatic; CAD/solver/release mutations require their registered producer/gate and may require human approval.
Requirement allocation changes are separate from requirement-text changes and invalidate every allocated target plus shared-interface counterpart reviews.
Derived engineering inputs propagate by quantity identity/derivation ID; equal numeric values do not couple unrelated analyses.
Product Definition domain slices are used to reduce over-invalidation: drawing, variation, inspection, physics, manufacturing and configuration consumers depend on the narrowest sufficient slice.
Downstream findings propagate upstream only through Engineering Feedback Records/change control; stale propagation never silently changes design intent.
Domain slice nodes consume their direct domain authorities, not K01.PD.P007.COMPILED as an input; otherwise an unrelated full-definition change would defeat narrow invalidation.
rebuild_rule: Topological order only. A node may rebuild only after required impacted predecessors are no longer STALE/DRIFT/BLOCKED/HOLD.
release_rule: Any stale or drifted release-path node keeps release HOLD. Release cannot be restored by editing the drawing/PDF status.
known_limitations: V9 canonical CAD semantics are assembly-level (K01.CAD.SEM.A001). Part geometry changes may conservatively over-invalidate unrelated CAD-semantic consumers until part-level semantic slice nodes are introduced. Under-invalidation is prohibited.

domain_slice_rule.product_definition: full compiled contract is traceability/readiness aggregation; downstream functional consumers use direct-authority domain slices unless they explicitly need the entire contract
domain_slice_rule.measurement_condition: drawing + variation + inspection/manufacturing slices as declared; physics only if a solver case explicitly consumes the condition
domain_slice_rule.supplier_capability: manufacturing + variation/inspection and release consumers; drawing only where route/process semantics are drawing-relevant
